utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we got a date set for the repair drive, or are we still figuring that out?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: We’re still figuring it out, but I’ll check with everyone and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — can you let me know once you’ve checked?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with the repair drive—just tell me what tools you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, uh, thanks Gus — I think we’ll need the wrench set and maybe a screwdriver. I’ll check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—just let me know, and I can bring the wrench set and a screwdriver when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of help already — folks are really showing up. If you’re thinking of pitching in, I can point you to where they’re organizing things.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear — I just want to make sure I know where to go and what to bring. If you point me to the organizers, I can see whether I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — they’re setting up by the community center entrance, and they said to bring gloves, basic tools if you have them, and a good pair of shoes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Opal. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you help by checking which homes are still waiting for repairs and noting the addresses? I’m keeping a simple list so we can follow up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check which homes are still waiting and jot down the addresses for you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in—want me to spread the word about the repair drive? I can invite a few neighbors and get folks moving.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d really help, Quinn. Thank you—I'll keep it simple and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — send me the details, and I’ll start inviting people right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any item lists or volunteer names, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hi Rosa — I’ll send over my item list and any volunteer names I have today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo — thank you. Send them when you’re ready, and I’ll slot everything into the drive list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details one more time so I get them right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’m late to the details too, but I can help if you want to resend what you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll resend what I have so we can check it together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Faye. We’re aiming for Saturday morning around 9, and if you could bring a clipboard and a few pens, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 works for me—I’ll bring a clipboard and some pens.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are signing up for tasks, and we’re mostly just lining up tools and supplies now. If you want, I can tell you which part still needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great — I’m still catching up, so tell me which part needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’m in, just point me to the basics and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirm you can help with the repair drive and I’ll send the basics.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help with the repair drive. Send me the basics and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thank you. I think the front gate needs fixing first; it’s been sticking lately.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll take a look at the front gate first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll help spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep the supply list updated and make sure we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan around the block and let people know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting some good traction. I’ll swing by after my errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll be around if you need a quick hand when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll check in after I finish my errands and see what’s left to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I knew I was forgetting something. What still needs doing, Vik?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly the sign-up list and a quick sweep of the tool table. I’ll remind everyone again and make sure the last bits get sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik — I can take the sweep of the tool table if you want. Just point me where to start so I don’t wander off again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What day did we settle on again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday afternoon, I think. I’ll check and confirm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — I probably missed that. Let me know when you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — that’d be a real help. I’ll make a simple list and let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be ready when you are. Just send the list over, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks! We still need a few volunteers to sort supplies and a couple of folks to help with the actual repairs—want me to add your name?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, please add my name for sorting supplies, and I can help with repairs too if you still need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive — it’s a good way to help folks out and bring people together. What part are you thinking about first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m thinking we start with the houses on Maple and then check the community center after that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds like a solid route. I can help organize the Maple houses first, then we’ll head over to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll help get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let’s start by listing the repairs folks need most.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — I’ll make a quick list of the biggest repair needs and what supplies we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — send me the list when you’re ready, and I’ll help sort it by urgency and make a supply checklist.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon — is there anything they still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — do they still need volunteers or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet, I only heard it through the grapevine — I can check and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll keep it brief and natural. What’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still lining up the school schedule around it, so I need to see what time works best. If you have the details, send them over and I’ll fit it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll send the time details over, and you can slot it into the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still willing to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still willing to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s moving along, but I’m a bit behind on the latest. What’s the update from your side?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little behind too, but I can swing by later and catch up on what’s been done. If you’ve got the latest list, I’d be glad to help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be really helpful, thanks. I don’t have the latest list yet, but I can check around and pass along whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’d be happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — could you help me keep track of the donated tools and where they’re dropped off? That’ll make the repair drive much easier to sort.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can keep track of the donated tools and where they’re dropped off. Just let me know the setup, and I’ll stay on top of it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got on hand and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can check it today? I’d like a clear list before we go any further.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I’ll check today and get you a clear list before we move ahead.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m putting together the repair drive invites now—want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, please add me to the list. Happy to help out where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll add you right now—thanks! I’ll send over the details once I’ve got the list set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m in—what should I bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you bring a flashlight, some gloves, and maybe a small tool kit? I’m just trying to keep the logistics simple so we don’t end up missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll bring a flashlight, gloves, and a small tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That repair drive sounds like a great way to get everyone pitching in. If you want, I can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be wonderful, Jules — thank you. Could you mention it to a few neighbors and point them to the details so I know everyone hears the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to a few neighbors and send them to the same details so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving, Rey. I can help line up the list and keep everything on track.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — that would really help. I can talk to people one by one and pass along what I hear.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll draft the list and jot down who needs what, and you can keep bringing me updates as you talk to folks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—folks are still dropping off tools and supplies. I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping an ear out—it's a big help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course, Uli—happy to help. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new about it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Eli, what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: I’ll sort the tools, and you can make the list of repairs. Then we’ll set a time and go one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll make the repair list. What time do you want to start?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll skim them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll send over the repair drive details now so you can skim them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send them over and I’ll take a quick look.
